checks: Exact named synthetic native tests; paired syntax projection
cost: Read O(bytes); spans O(chars+spans log spans) memory O(chars+depth+spans), bracket intersection O((a+b)log distinct). Main pairwise comparisons O(system²*tokens), holds all outputs; no parser/model invocation. Numeric sums assume no overflow.
description: read_conllu ignores read errors, short/range/dotted rows, defaults malformed head to u32::MAX and lowercases relation. Score counts head matches, UD-only base LAS and gold-PUNCT exclusion. spans strips functional label suffixes, excludes root/preterminals and sorts half-open word spans. bracket_f1 counts multiset intersection. Main aligns by counts/order, requires two UD voters, ties smaller head, flags changed head at >=0.75 support; writes three reports sequentially. agree uses first system punctuation mask for all pairs.

inverse: Scores constrain numbers of matching positions but cannot recover trees; spans lose words, POS/preterminal labels and root wrapper; multiset F1 loses identities of missed spans.
Non-UD systems never contribute LAS or majority votes. Span duplicates contribute at most minimum multiplicity. Token count alignment does not validate matching forms/ids or safe heads.
limitations: Partial source models and finite fixtures only. No corpus/model/network/site/release execution or universal proof.
